messages.text: A and I both want the trailer in the next few weeks, and neither of us is backing down. B's pad is where it lives, so she is stuck in the middle. Can you help the three of us sort this out?

I need the trailer for my home project in the next few weeks. I’m worried the decision will just leave me waiting until A is done. I can coordinate, but I can’t decide for A or B. “Not backing down” isn’t quite right—I’m saying I need us to settle this soon.

I don’t need the trailer myself, and I’d be relieved to have it out of the way—though I do feel I agreed to this arrangement. I rent, so any change to what’s kept on the pad would need my landlord’s approval, and I haven’t asked him yet.
I need the trailer for weekend trips in the next few weeks. I don’t want C’s refusal to budge to decide for all of us; I want a say too.
I need it for weekend trips starting in the next few weeks. I’m worried C’s urgency will mean C decides the schedule for everyone. I want a real say in when I can use it.
That split could work, but I can’t name exact days yet. I need the trailer for hauling sometime in the next few weeks, so let’s set my project days alongside A’s weekends soon.
I haven’t set the weekends yet. The split could work, but I’m not agreeing to fixed dates until we compare schedules and agree how the handoffs work.
I can’t narrow it to a particular week yet; I need it sometime in the next few weeks. Please don’t schedule my use only after A’s trips.
I haven’t checked my calendar, so I can’t name the weekends yet. Don’t mark anything fixed; I’ll send the dates once I’ve checked.

Comparing preferences works; the handoff rules still need all three of us to agree. My first choice is the earliest available weekday in the next few weeks—not only after A’s trips. I can’t give exact dates yet.
Those handoff rules sound fine to me. I can’t confirm the trailer can stay on my pad between uses: I haven’t checked with my landlord, and I’d rather it not stay there.
The process works, including the handoff rules. I haven’t checked my calendar, so I can’t name my top two weekends yet.
I haven’t confirmed a place to store it, so I can’t promise I can. I need the dates firmed within the next few weeks—ideally soon.
